hints: Each book can be chosen once, so decide for every book whether to include it.
Let dp[b] be the greatest pages achievable at total price b.
Traverse budgets downward for each book; upward traversal would let that same book be reused.
analogy: Each book is a one-time offer; update budgets from high to low so the offer cannot be picked twice.
example: With budget 10, books costing 4 and 5 with 5 and 8 pages yield 13 pages at total cost 9.
algorithm: Use 0/1 knapsack: initialize dp[0..x]=0; for each book (price h,pages s), loop b=x down to h and set dp[b]=max(dp[b],dp[b-h]+s). Answer max dp.
correctness: Descending budgets ensure the transition uses only states from before this book, so each selected book appears at most once; maximizing pages under budget checks all subsets.
